items.text: Nico Collins listed OUT (hamstring) for Week 2 vs CIN in ETR Sunday injury roundup; corroborated by Schefter/Rapoport as ruled out after missing practices.
items.why: Hamstring injury suffered in Wednesday practice; missed subsequent practices.
items.implication: Remove from lineups; HOU WR room thins to Hutchinson/Boutte/Noel with Schultz TE bump.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining HOU pass-catchers.

items.text: Zay Flowers (and Ja'Kobi Lane) OUT OR DOUBTFUL for Week 2 vs NO; Schefter/Rap list Flowers doubtful (hamstring).
items.why: Hamstring; missed multiple practices, limited Friday return still doubtful.
items.opportunity: Ravens WR hierarchy shifts to Bateman/Walker/Wester if out.

items.text: Brock Bowers OUT OR DOUBTFUL (knee) Week 2 vs LAC per ETR; Schefter/Rap confirm doubtful after meniscus issues, limited practice.
items.why: Knee/meniscus recovery; practiced Friday but listed doubtful by HC.
items.implication: TE streamers needed; low chance of meaningful role if active.

items.text: Ladd McConkey QUESTIONABLE (ribs) Week 2 vs LV; practiced Friday limited, Schefter confirms Q.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1; limited Friday after two DNPs.
items.implication: Late game (4pm ET); have backup ready; impacts Herbert projections heavily.
items.opportunity: If out, Quentin Johnston/Tre Harris upside.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is the biggest injury on the slate; affects many projections including Justin Herbert. Game at 4pm ET.
items.why: Ribs limit; cascade to LAC offense volume/roles.
items.implication: Herbert downgrade if limited/out; monitor closely.
items.opportunity: LAC WR2+ upside if McConkey sits.

items.text: Patriots desperately need playmakers (AJ Brown IR); do they give TreVeyon Henderson 10+ touches in 2026 debut? Returning at right time with nice matchups ahead.
items.why: Explosive need post-Brown IR; schedule (PIT/JAX/BUF etc) favorable pre-bye.
items.implication: FLEX/RB3 upside; unclear exact split vs Stevenson.

items.text: Joe Burrow QUESTIONABLE (back) but said he's playing; ETR notes expectation to play vs HOU.
items.why: Back injury; full practice/said playing but official Q.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson listed IN for Week 2 debut vs PIT after ankle absence.
items.opportunity: Explosive role vs Stevenson with AJ Brown IR; strong upcoming schedule.

items.text: Alvin Kamara listed IN for Week 2 vs BAL.
items.opportunity: Third-down/receiving work likely returns to Kamara.

items.text: If Zay Flowers can't go (Ja'Kobi Lane IR), Ravens WRs: 1. Rashod Bateman 2. Devontez Walker 3. LaJohntay Wester etc. BAL down to crumbs at WR.
items.why: Hamstring DNP streak + Lane out creates vacuum.
items.opportunity: Target share jump for remaining BAL WRs/TE.

items.text: LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: 21/24 RB touches (74% snaps), 40% routes targeted (team lead); IND allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.implication: Must-start RB1 upside; potential overall RB1 season.

items.text: LOVE Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization (2nd only to Bijan), 19% tgt share recent; overreaction to injury scare.
items.why: Elite util under Kubiak; passing-game involvement.

items.text: Giving Christian McCaffrey a bump off Week 1 usage regardless, but Kaelon Black (groin) status does matter.
items.why: Strong Week 1 usage baseline; Black Q could expand role further.

items.text: HATE Travis Etienne @ BAL: Matched Kendre Miller rushes Week 1, air-heavy fantasy; Kamara expected back squeezes role further as underdogs.
items.why: Committee squeeze with Kamara return + poor script.
items.conflict: Kamara IN reverses prior Etienne standalone.
